requirements.title: ATAND arguments satisfy the source restrictions
requirements.definition: Y shall be real. If Y appears, X shall be real with the same kind type parameter as Y and X shall not be zero when Y is zero. If Y does not appear, X shall be real.

pending.atand-y-real-when-present: Positive plan: call ATAND(Y,X) with real nonzero Y and X; wrong-type Y remains a non-diagnostic source-control mutation.
pending.atand-x-real-without-y: Positive plan: call one-argument ATAND(X) with X initialized to a nonzero real sentinel value; wrong-type X remains a non-diagnostic source-control mutation.
pending.atand-x-same-kind-as-y-when-y-present: Positive plan: call two-argument ATAND with X and Y of the same selected real kind and assert the result kind equals KIND(X); a different-kind source mutation is not a diagnostic oracle.
pending.atand-not-both-zero-when-y-zero: Positive plan: exercise the two-argument form with Y==0 and nonzero X, plus a nonzero-Y control; do not claim a required diagnostic for Y==0,X==0.

requirements.title: ATAND two-argument result matches ATAN2D and one-argument result is degree-valued
requirements.definition: If Y appears, ATAND(Y,X) has the same result as ATAN2D(Y,X). If Y does not appear, ATAND(X) approximates the arc tangent of X, is expressed in degrees, and lies in the range -90 through 90.

pending.atand-two-argument-same-as-atan2d: Concrete plan: compute ATAND(Y,X) and ATAN2D(Y,X) for the same sentinel-initialized same-kind real inputs with nonzero X/Y and assert equality between the two processor results, not a fixed decimal angle.
pending.atand-one-argument-degree-range: Concrete plan: call one-argument ATAND(X) for initialized finite X values such as -1.0, 0.0, and 1.0, store into a sentinel, and assert only membership in [-90, 90].
